evidence_limit: HDD type does not establish boot or storage role.
Capacity and drive-days do not measure read/write activity.
Only one model and four vaults have baseline SMART readings. Raw units need verification.
Eligibility and feature choices affect groups. Cluster labels do not establish reliability or cause.
Poisson assumptions and dependent peer tests limit interpretation. Holm controls multiple testing under valid individual tests.
Selected baseline survivors, missing follow-up and maintenance flags prevent a mechanical-failure or causal interpretation.
